description: Server-side route handler for the product list page and CRUD actions in a SvelteKit project. Handles fetching, creating, updating, and deleting invoice products via API calls, with filtering, pagination, and transformation logic.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the list of products with filtering, pagination, and transformation for the frontend.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles creating a new invoice product via API request.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing invoice product via API request.

methods.name: actions.delete
methods.description: Handles deleting an invoice product via API request.
